ai.instructions: Ninety is an EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) platform. Terms: Rocks are 90-day priorities (quarterly goals) with Milestones; Issues are items on a Team's Issues List to be solved with IDS (Identify, Discuss, Solve), split into Short-Term and Long-Term; To-Dos are 7-day action items; Headlines are short good/bad news updates for a Team's meeting; Cascading Messages are Headlines sent down from leadership; the Scorecard tracks weekly Measurables (also called KPIs). Most tools need a Team Id: when the user names a Team, call get-teams first and match the name. If the Team is ambiguous, ask the user. Items created through the API are always owned by the user. When listing items, keep answers short and include due dates and status. Items include a `url` to open them in Ninety; when you mention a specific item, link its title with that url.

evals.input: @ninety add an issue to the Leadership team: hiring plan for Q1
@ninety add a personal to-do to send the board deck by 2026-11-06
@ninety mark my to-do 'Send proposal to Acme' as done
@ninety what's on the Leadership team's issues list?
@ninety how are my rocks tracking this quarter?
@ninety mark my rock 'Launch onboarding flow' as off track
@ninety any headlines for the Leadership team?
@ninety share a headline with Leadership: Northwind renewed for 3 years
@ninety when is the Leadership team's next meeting?
@ninety how is the Leadership scorecard looking this week?

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: Personal Access Token
preferences.description: Generate one at https://app.ninety.io/settings/user/developer-settings (User Settings → Developer Settings → Generate New Token). Requires a Thrive or Legacy plan.

preferences.name: email
preferences.title: Your Ninety Email
preferences.description: Optional, but needed for My Rocks and your avatar. Ninety's API has no way to look up the signed-in user, so the extension finds you by this email.

preferences.name: avatarUrl
preferences.title: Your Avatar URL
preferences.description: Optional. Ninety's API doesn't share profile photos, so people show as initials. Paste the link to your Ninety photo (right-click your avatar in Ninety, then Copy Image Address) to show it on items you own.

" && exit 1
